name: agents-world
description: A browser-based 2D life simulation where every human is an independent AI agent.

scripts.start: bun run --cwd apps/web build && bun run --cwd apps/server start
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "bun run --cwd apps/server dev" "bun run --cwd apps/web dev"
scripts.test:e2e: bun run --cwd apps/web build && playwright test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run test
